inventory_name: ParamGuard Vision minimal observed supply-chain registry
scope: Observed development and OCR runtime artifacts; excludes build-only tooling, operating-system frameworks, and exhaustive transitive closure.

components.name: CPython
components.scope_note: Primary CPython license only; incorporated component terms remain in the upstream LICENSE.

components.name: Pillow
components.observation_method: importlib.metadata version and SHA-256 of installed distribution RECORD
components.scope_note: The installed wheel license bundle can include additional codec notices; preserve that bundle when redistributing.

components.name: Aileron Regular subset
components.observation_method: Decoded ImageFont.load_default asset, inspected OpenType name table, and hashed exact embedded bytes
components.scope_note: Separate from Pillow's MIT-CMU code license; ParamGuard calls load_default and emits rasterized glyphs, not a standalone font file.

components.name: Tesseract OCR
components.observation_method: tesseract --version and SHA-256 of the resolved executable
components.scope_note: The engine has separate native and trained-data dependencies recorded below.

components.name: eng
components.observation_method: tesseract --list-langs, installed artifact SHA-256, and package formula source pin
components.scope_note: This is the only language explicitly selected by ParamGuard's default OCR configuration.

components.name: osd
components.observation_method: tesseract --list-langs, installed artifact SHA-256, and package formula source pin
components.scope_note: Installed and therefore inventoried, but not selected by ParamGuard's current OCR configuration.

components.name: snum
components.observation_method: tesseract --list-langs, installed artifact SHA-256, repository metadata, and package formula source pin
components.scope_note: The source repository exposes no root license; do not redistribute or enable this inactive model until reviewed or removed from a controlled runtime.

components.name: Leptonica
components.scope_note: Primary Tesseract image-processing library; standalone native artifact digest was not captured.

integrity.value: Tesseract self-report; no standalone native artifact digest captured

components.name: giflib

integrity.value: Tesseract self-report; no standalone native artifact digest captured
